lastCompletedStory.title: Derive officialDocsValidated status enum and allowed keys from handoff.schema.json

nextStoryContext: resolveJsonModule is now enabled in tsconfig.json and src/supervisor/events.ts imports scripts/cam/handoff.schema.json as a static JSON module. OFFICIAL_DOCS_VALIDATED_STATUSES and OFFICIAL_DOCS_VALIDATED_ALLOWED_KEYS are now derived at runtime from that import (handoffSchema.properties.officialDocsValidated.items.properties.status.enum and Object.keys(...properties)) instead of hand-copied literals. Editing the status enum or the item's property set in handoff.schema.json alone now updates the runtime validator with no second edit in events.ts. bun build --compile inlines the JSON import fine (verified via bun run build:release). The file-size-budget.json ceiling for src/supervisor/events.ts was raised 662->663 with a tracker ref in _ref.

officialDocsValidated.summary: resolveJsonModule needs no companion flag and infers literal types per-property from the JSON's static shape; matches the property-path access used in events.ts and the clean bun run typecheck result.
